DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Risk_Customers'[risk_level], "Total_Customers", '_Measures'[Total Customers])

	VAR __DS0BodyLimited = 
		TOPN(1002, __DS0Core, [Total_Customers], 0, 'Risk_Customers'[risk_level], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyLimited

ORDER BY
	[Total_Customers] DESC, 'Risk_Customers'[risk_level]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Action_Board'[priority], "Total_Actions", '_Measures'[Total Actions])

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Total_Actions], 0, 'Action_Board'[priority], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[Total_Actions] DESC, 'Action_Board'[priority]

EVALUATE
	ROW(
		"Total_Customers", '_Measures'[Total Customers],
		"High_Risk_Customers", '_Measures'[High Risk Customers],
		"Open_Actions", '_Measures'[Open Actions],
		"Overdue_Actions", '_Measures'[Overdue Actions],
		"RiskOps_Pressure_Score", '_Measures'[RiskOps Pressure Score]
	)

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(
				SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
					ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL(
						ROLLUPGROUP(
							'Risk_Customers'[Customer Alias],
							'Risk_Customers'[risk_level],
							'Risk_Customers'[risk_score],
							'Risk_Customers'[confidence],
							'Risk_Customers'[top_reasons],
							'Risk_Customers'[next_best_action],
							'Risk_Customers'[owner],
							'Risk_Customers'[Due Date]
						), "IsGrandTotalRowTotal"
					),
					"MinRisk_Level_Bg_Color", IGNORE(CALCULATE(MIN('Risk_Customers'[Risk Level Bg Color])))
				)
			),
			OR(
				OR(
					OR(
						OR(
							OR(
								OR(
									OR(
										NOT(ISBLANK('Risk_Customers'[Customer Alias])),
										NOT(ISBLANK('Risk_Customers'[risk_level]))
									),
									NOT(ISBLANK('Risk_Customers'[risk_score]))
								),
								NOT(ISBLANK('Risk_Customers'[confidence]))
							),
							NOT(ISBLANK('Risk_Customers'[top_reasons]))
						),
						NOT(ISBLANK('Risk_Customers'[next_best_action]))
					),
					NOT(ISBLANK('Risk_Customers'[owner]))
				),
				NOT(ISBLANK('Risk_Customers'[Due Date]))
			)
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(
			502,
			__DS0Core,
			[IsGrandTotalRowTotal],
			0,
			'Risk_Customers'[risk_score],
			0,
			'Risk_Customers'[Customer Alias],
			1,
			'Risk_Customers'[risk_level],
			1,
			'Risk_Customers'[confidence],
			1,
			'Risk_Customers'[top_reasons],
			1,
			'Risk_Customers'[next_best_action],
			1,
			'Risk_Customers'[owner],
			1,
			'Risk_Customers'[Due Date],
			1
		)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[IsGrandTotalRowTotal] DESC,
	'Risk_Customers'[risk_score] DESC,
	'Risk_Customers'[Customer Alias],
	'Risk_Customers'[risk_level],
	'Risk_Customers'[confidence],
	'Risk_Customers'[top_reasons],
	'Risk_Customers'[next_best_action],
	'Risk_Customers'[owner],
	'Risk_Customers'[Due Date]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Risk_Customers'[risk_level], "Total_Customers", '_Measures'[Total Customers])

	VAR __DS0BodyLimited = 
		TOPN(1002, __DS0Core, [Total_Customers], 0, 'Risk_Customers'[risk_level], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyLimited

ORDER BY
	[Total_Customers] DESC, 'Risk_Customers'[risk_level]

EVALUATE

		"Open_Actions", '_Measures'[Open Actions],
		"Overdue_Actions", '_Measures'[Overdue Actions],

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(
				SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
					ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL(

							'Risk_Customers'[Customer Alias],

							'Risk_Customers'[risk_score],

							'Risk_Customers'[next_best_action],

						), "IsGrandTotalRowTotal"
					),

				)
			),
			OR(
				OR(
					OR(
						OR(
							OR(
								OR(

										NOT(ISBLANK('Risk_Customers'[Customer Alias])),

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed =

			1,

			1,

			1,

			1,
			'Risk_Customers'[next_best_action],
			1,

			1,

			1
		)

EVALUATE

ORDER BY

	'Risk_Customers'[risk_score] DESC,
	'Risk_Customers'[Customer Alias],
	'Risk_Customers'[risk_level],
	'Risk_Customers'[confidence],
	'Risk_Customers'[top_reasons],
	'Risk_Customers'[next_best_action],
	'Risk_Customers'[owner],
	'Risk_Customers'[Due Date]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Risk_Customers'[Customer Alias],
			"Averagerisk_score", CALCULATE(AVERAGE('Risk_Customers'[risk_score])),
			"Minrisk_level", IGNORE(CALCULATE(MIN('Risk_Customers'[risk_level]))),
			"Mintop_reasons", IGNORE(CALCULATE(MIN('Risk_Customers'[top_reasons]))),
			"Minnext_best_action", IGNORE(CALCULATE(MIN('Risk_Customers'[next_best_action])))
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Averagerisk_score], 0, 'Risk_Customers'[Customer Alias], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[Averagerisk_score] DESC, 'Risk_Customers'[Customer Alias]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		VALUES('Risk_Customers'[risk_level])

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(101, __DS0Core, 'Risk_Customers'[risk_level], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	'Risk_Customers'[risk_level]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(
				SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
					'Risk_Customers'[risk_level],
					'Risk_Customers'[risk_score],
					'Risk_Customers'[confidence],
					"Mintop_reasons", IGNORE(CALCULATE(MIN('Risk_Customers'[top_reasons]))),
					"Minnext_best_action", IGNORE(CALCULATE(MIN('Risk_Customers'[next_best_action])))
				)
			),
			OR(
				OR(
					NOT(ISBLANK('Risk_Customers'[risk_level])),
					NOT(ISBLANK('Risk_Customers'[risk_score]))
				),
				NOT(ISBLANK('Risk_Customers'[confidence]))
			)
		)

	VAR __DS0IntersectionCount = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(__DS0Core))

	VAR __DS0BodyOverlappingPointsSample = 
		SAMPLECARTESIANPOINTSBYCOVER(3500, __DS0Core, 'Risk_Customers'[risk_score], 'Risk_Customers'[confidence])

EVALUATE
	ROW(
	"DS0IntersectionCount", __DS0IntersectionCount
)

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyOverlappingPointsSample

ORDER BY
	'Risk_Customers'[risk_level],
	'Risk_Customers'[risk_score],
	'Risk_Customers'[confidence]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Risk_Drivers'[risk_driver],
			"CountCustomer_Alias", CALCULATE(COUNTA('Risk_Drivers'[Customer Alias]))
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [CountCustomer_Alias], 0, 'Risk_Drivers'[risk_driver], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[CountCustomer_Alias] DESC, 'Risk_Drivers'[risk_driver]

DEFINE

				SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
					ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL(
						ROLLUPGROUP(
							'Risk_Drivers'[Customer Alias],
							'Risk_Drivers'[risk_level],
							'Risk_Drivers'[risk_score],
							'Risk_Drivers'[risk_driver]
						), "IsGrandTotalRowTotal"
					),
					"MinDriver_Risk_Level_Bg_Color", IGNORE(CALCULATE(MIN('Risk_Drivers'[Driver Risk Level Bg Color])))
				)
			),

	'Risk_Drivers'[risk_driver],
	'Risk_Drivers'[Customer Alias],
	'Risk_Drivers'[risk_level],
	'Risk_Drivers'[risk_score]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Risk_Customers'[Confidence Band],
			"Total_Customers", '_Measures'[Total Customers]
		)

metrics.QueryText:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Risk_Customers'[risk_level],
			"Averagerisk_score", CALCULATE(AVERAGE('Risk_Customers'[risk_score]))
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Averagerisk_score], 0, 'Risk_Customers'[risk_level], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[Averagerisk_score] DESC, 'Risk_Customers'[risk_level]

EVALUATE
	ROW(
		"Average_Confidence", '_Measures'[Average Confidence],
		"Confidence_Coverage", '_Measures'[Confidence Coverage],
		"Low_Confidence_Customers", '_Measures'[Low Confidence Customers],
		"Average_Risk_Score", '_Measures'[Average Risk Score]
	)

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZE(
			'Risk_Customers',
			'Risk_Customers'[Customer Alias],
			'Risk_Customers'[risk_level],
			'Risk_Customers'[risk_score],
			'Risk_Customers'[confidence],
			'Risk_Customers'[Confidence Band],
			'Risk_Customers'[top_reasons]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(
			501,
			__DS0Core,
			'Risk_Customers'[Customer Alias],
			1,
			'Risk_Customers'[risk_level],
			1,
			'Risk_Customers'[risk_score],
			1,
			'Risk_Customers'[confidence],
			1,
			'Risk_Customers'[Confidence Band],
			1,
			'Risk_Customers'[top_reasons],
			1
		)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	'Risk_Customers'[Customer Alias],
	'Risk_Customers'[risk_level],
	'Risk_Customers'[risk_score],
	'Risk_Customers'[confidence],
	'Risk_Customers'[Confidence Band],
	'Risk_Customers'[top_reasons]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Action_Board'[status], "Total_Actions", '_Measures'[Total Actions])

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Total_Actions], 0, 'Action_Board'[status], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[Total_Actions] DESC, 'Action_Board'[status]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Action_Board'[owner], "Total_Actions", '_Measures'[Total Actions])

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Total_Actions], 0, 'Action_Board'[owner], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[Total_Actions] DESC, 'Action_Board'[owner]

EVALUATE
	ROW(
		"Total_Actions", '_Measures'[Total Actions],
		"Open_Actions", '_Measures'[Open Actions],
		"High_Priority_Actions", '_Measures'[High Priority Actions],
		"Overdue_Actions", '_Measures'[Overdue Actions]
	)

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(
				SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
					ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL(
						ROLLUPGROUP(
							'Action_Board'[Action Alias],
							'Action_Board'[Action Index],
							'Action_Board'[priority],
							'Action_Board'[status],
							'Action_Board'[action_label],
							'Action_Board'[owner],
							'Action_Board'[Action Due Date Display],
							'Action_Board'[evidence_count],
							'Action_Board'[Action Customer Alias]
						), "IsGrandTotalRowTotal"
					),
					"MinPriority_Bg_Color", IGNORE(CALCULATE(MIN('Action_Board'[Priority Bg Color]))),
					"MinStatus_Bg_Color", IGNORE(CALCULATE(MIN('Action_Board'[Status Bg Color])))
				)
			),
			OR(
				OR(
					OR(
						OR(
							OR(
								OR(
									OR(
										OR(
											NOT(ISBLANK('Action_Board'[Action Alias])),
											NOT(ISBLANK('Action_Board'[Action Index]))
										),
										NOT(ISBLANK('Action_Board'[priority]))
									),
									NOT(ISBLANK('Action_Board'[status]))
								),
								NOT(ISBLANK('Action_Board'[action_label]))
							),
							NOT(ISBLANK('Action_Board'[owner]))
						),
						NOT(ISBLANK('Action_Board'[Action Due Date Display]))
					),
					NOT(ISBLANK('Action_Board'[evidence_count]))
				),
				NOT(ISBLANK('Action_Board'[Action Customer Alias]))
			)
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(
			502,
			__DS0Core,
			[IsGrandTotalRowTotal],
			0,
			'Action_Board'[action_label],
			1,
			'Action_Board'[Action Index],
			1,
			'Action_Board'[Action Alias],
			1,
			'Action_Board'[priority],
			1,
			'Action_Board'[status],
			1,
			'Action_Board'[owner],
			1,
			'Action_Board'[Action Due Date Display],
			1,
			'Action_Board'[evidence_count],
			1,
			'Action_Board'[Action Customer Alias],
			1
		)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[IsGrandTotalRowTotal] DESC,
	'Action_Board'[action_label],
	'Action_Board'[Action Index],
	'Action_Board'[Action Alias],
	'Action_Board'[priority],
	'Action_Board'[status],
	'Action_Board'[owner],
	'Action_Board'[Action Due Date Display],
	'Action_Board'[evidence_count],
	'Action_Board'[Action Customer Alias]
